references.text: Joshua explains that the Lord allowed nations to remain to test Israel, which aligns with God letting nations stay without driving them out quickly.
Explains further why the Lord left these nations behind—to test Israel and teach them warfare.
Moses prophesied that the Lord would drive out the nations little by little, not all at once, which is fulfilled here.
God promised not to drive out the peoples in one year, but gradually, so that the land would not become desolate.
Describes how Joshua was old and there was still much land left to take, showing that not everything was given into Joshua's hand.
Joshua rebukes Israel for being slow to take possession of the land the Lord had given them.
